_doc: Rung-4 animation fixtures (docs/pc-test-rig.md): each names blueprints to stage and the expected distinct-state band [min,max] PER APP over a 12-frame jittered burst. Bands are MEASURED (2026-08-05 first baseline) except where noted aspirational: a band the Raves side currently fails documents the porting target. `checker.py anim <fixture>` measures; classes: static(1) / discrete / continuous(>=75% frames unique).

warm-static.notes: MEASURED AGREE: qud 4 / raves 3-4 discrete. The recurring pixel-pass WARN/FAILs are pure phase mismatch â€” the animation itself is congruent. Candidate for anim-aware banding in the scored sweep.

machine-tubing.notes: EXONERATED: the '11 continuous states' were sub-noise brightness breathing (~1.8 mean/pair; noise floor 3.5 clusters them). Both apps read 1 static — AGREE. Not an animation.

conveyor.notes: AGREE both boots, state count varies with conditions: 4/3 discrete one boot, 1/1 static on a fresh unpowered stage (belt likely needs drive power to roll). Parity holds either way; band spans both.

phasic-screw.notes: PORTED 2026-08-05: AnimatedMaterialGeneric exported as animFrames and played client-side. Raves measures 5-6 discrete (was 1 static). Qud-side re-measure pending the frozen-capture question (findings section 10).

switch-blink.notes: MEASURED AGREE at 1/1: an UNPOWERED switch does not blink. The furniture pixel FAILs for Switch are therefore a STATIC art difference, not animation â€” re-triage against the evidence crops (findings section 6 revised).

campfire.notes: MEASURED AGREE: qud 11 / raves 12 continuous. The sanity case.

walls-tail.notes: The bright-baseline walls FAIL tail — run-to-run variable scores (HangarWall probed PASS 12 then swept 47). Measure to classify.

plants-tail.notes: Plants FAIL tail (pricklers puff, holograms flicker, chimes swing?).

furniture-tail.notes: Furniture FAIL tail minus the Switch family (measured static — real art difference, findings s6) and the conveyors/phasic (already fixtured).

creatures-tail.notes: Representative sample of the creatures FAIL tail (Cherubim spawners handled separately — they REPLACE themselves between captures; KNOWN).
